# DWM Audiology

> > Independent audiology clinic in Melbourne offering comprehensive hearing tests, hearing aids, tinnitus management, and personalized aural rehabilitation services.

DWM Audiology is an established independent clinic in Heidelberg, Melbourne with over 30 years of experience. The practice specializes in diagnostic audiology, hearing aid fitting and adjustment, tinnitus and hyperacusis management, and aural rehabilitation, supported by a team of experienced audiologists.

## Key Topics

- Hearing aids
- Hearing tests
- Tinnitus management
- Audiology services
- Aural rehabilitation
- Hearing aid fitting
- Audiologists
- Melbourne audiology
- Hyperacusis
- Hearing assessment
- Acoustic shock
- Audiology Australia
- Medicare rebates
- NDIS
- Hearing aid adjustment

## Core Services

- [Audiology Services](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services): Overview of DWM audiology services: hearing tests, aids, tinnitus, hyperacusis management.
- [Hearing Tests](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-tests): Professional hearing tests for adults and children with expert audiologists.
- [Adult Hearing Tests Melbourne](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-tests-for-adults): Comprehensive adult hearing assessments with Medicare rebates in Melbourne.
- [Children's Hearing Tests Melbourne](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-tests-for-kids): Pediatric hearing tests from 9+ months with expert audiology care.
- [Hearing Aids Melbourne](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-aid-services): Hearing aid services: fittings, cleaning, tuning, and consultations.
- [Hearing Aid Fittings In Melbourne](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-aid-services/hearing-aid-fittings): Tailored hearing aid fitting services in Melbourne with professional support.

## Hearing Aid Guides

- [Do I Need A Hearing Aid?](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-aid-services/do-i-need-a-hearing-aid): Guide to assess hearing aid need and explore hearing loss solutions.
- [How to Choose The Right Hearing Aid](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-aid-services/choosing-hearing-aids): Guide to hearing aid styles, technology, and selection with audiologist expertise.
- [How To Get Used To Hearing Aids](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-aid-services/getting-used-to-hearing-aids): Comprehensive guide to hearing aid adjustment and adaptation period.
- [Fine-Tuning Hearing Aids](https://www.dwmaudiology.com.au/services/hearing-aid-services/fine-tuning-hearing-aids): Hearing aid fine-tuning and programming services for personalized solutions.
